'''Komagata-Ōshige Shrine''' (こまがたおおしげじんじゃ) is a Shinto shrine located in Narahara, Gose City, Nara Prefecture.

=== Overview ===
In 1907 (Meiji 40), Ōshige Shrine, which had been enshrined in the eastern area known as Taguchi, was merged into Komagata Shrine, forming its present configuration.<ref name="city">[https://www.city.gose.nara.jp/kankou/0000001414.html Komagata-Ōshige Shrine] – Gose City</ref><ref name="kotobank">[https://kotobank.jp/word/駒形大重神社-3081535 Komagata-Ōshige Shrine] – Kotobank</ref>.

While Komagata Shrine enshrines a local tutelary deity known in legend as Kimata-sama, Ōshige Shrine is identified with “Katsuraki Ōshige Shrine” listed in the Yamato Province, Katsukami District section of the *Engishiki Jinmyōchō*, making it a Shikinaisha. Its enshrined deity is said to be either Shigeno no Sadamochi or Katsuragi no Wakainukai Amida.<ref name="city"/><ref name="kotobank"/>.

=== Enshrined deities ===
* Kimata-no-Kami
* Shigeno no Sadamochi, or Katsuragi no Wakainukai Amida
